title: Paper White 2: the spawn groups, res/paperwhite2/overworld/groups.json
description: Sets of NPCs, instances and ambients of which at most one member appears at a time, in one zone or across several (docs/paperwhite2/design/overworld-editor.md, Groups). A member names its group in its zone's file ("group"). Packed by tools/paperwhite2/overworld.py into each zone's table that has a member of the group.

id.description: What its members name it by

zone.description: The zone it belongs to (a ZONE_* constant), where the editor lists it; it's also listed in each zone with a member of it. None for a group of its own

rolls.description: How long its pick holds: the hour (by default), the day, the time of day, or each zone entry. A group with members in several zones can't roll each entry

nobody.description: The weight of no member appearing, against the members' weights; 0 by default
